3 /-! A broken wedge arm meets each circle about its root exactly once.
4 This gives an explicit polar description of the arm-rotation step.
5 The outer ray must point away from the root; in Kiazyk's notation this
6 is the condition `π/2 ≤ γ ≤ 3π/2`.
7 -/
8 
9 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge
10 
11 open Real Set
12 
13 /-- Distance along an outward unit ray, from an elbow of radius `d`
14 to the circle of radius `ρ`. Here `(c,s)` is the ray's unit direction
15 relative to the radial direction of the elbow. -/
16 noncomputable def travel (d c s ρ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
17   sqrt (ρ ^ 2 - d ^ 2 * s ^ 2) - d * c
18 
19 /-- The square-root formula gives a nonnegative distance and a point on the circle. -/
20 theorem travel_spec {d c s ρ : ℝ} (dp : 0 < d) (outward : 0 ≤ c)
21     (unit : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (outside : d ≤ ρ) :
22     0 ≤ travel d c s ρ ∧
23       (d + travel d c s ρ * c) ^ 2 + (travel d c s ρ * s) ^ 2 = ρ ^ 2 := by
24   have dc : 0 ≤ d * c := mul_nonneg dp.le outward
25   have scaled : d ^ 2 * c ^ 2 + d ^ 2 * s ^ 2 = d ^ 2 := by
26     nlinarith [congrArg (fun x : ℝ => d ^ 2 * x) unit]
27   have radicand : 0 ≤ ρ ^ 2 - d ^ 2 * s ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (d * c)]
28   have root_nonneg := sqrt_nonneg (ρ ^ 2 - d ^ 2 * s ^ 2)
29   have root_square := sq_sqrt radicand
30   have root_bound : d * c ≤ sqrt (ρ ^ 2 - d ^ 2 * s ^ 2) := by nlinarith
31   refine ⟨sub_nonneg.mpr root_bound, ?_⟩
32   have scaled' := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => (travel d c s ρ) ^ 2 * x) unit
33   have equation : (travel d c s ρ) ^ 2 + 2 * d * c * travel d c s ρ = ρ ^ 2 - d ^ 2 := by
34     unfold travel
35     nlinarith
36   nlinarith
37 
38 /-- A point on the right half of a circle has these exact Cartesian polar coordinates. -/
39 private theorem polar_of_right_circle {ρ x y : ℝ} (rp : 0 < ρ) (xp : 0 ≤ x)
40     (circle : x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 = ρ ^ 2) :
41     ρ * cos (arcsin (y / ρ)) = x ∧ ρ * sin (arcsin (y / ρ)) = y := by
42   have low : -1 ≤ y / ρ := (le_div_iff₀ rp).mpr (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg x])
43   have high : y / ρ ≤ 1 := (div_le_iff₀ rp).mpr (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg x])
44   have sine : ρ * sin (arcsin (y / ρ)) = y := by
45     rw [sin_arcsin low high]
46     field_simp
47   refine ⟨?_, sine⟩
48   have cosine := cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc (arcsin_mem_Icc (y / ρ))
49   have scaled := congrArg (fun a : ℝ => ρ ^ 2 * a) (cos_sq_add_sin_sq (arcsin (y / ρ)))
50   have positive := mul_nonneg rp.le cosine
51   nlinarith [congrArg (fun a : ℝ => a ^ 2) sine]
52 
53 /-- At every radius outside the elbow, the displayed angle lies on the actual straight ray. -/
54 theorem ray_polar_coordinates {d c s ρ : ℝ} (dp : 0 < d) (outward : 0 ≤ c)
55     (unit : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (outside : d ≤ ρ) :
56     ρ * cos (arcsin (travel d c s ρ * s / ρ)) = d + travel d c s ρ * c ∧
57     ρ * sin (arcsin (travel d c s ρ * s / ρ)) = travel d c s ρ * s := by
58   have spec := travel_spec dp outward unit outside
59   exact polar_of_right_circle (dp.trans_le outside)
60     (add_nonneg dp.le (mul_nonneg spec.1 outward)) spec.2
61 
62 /-- An outward ray cannot meet the same circle twice. -/
63 theorem ray_circle_unique {d c s ρ t : ℝ} (dp : 0 < d) (outward : 0 ≤ c)
64     (unit : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (outside : d ≤ ρ) (tp : 0 ≤ t)
65     (circle : (d + t * c) ^ 2 + (t * s) ^ 2 = ρ ^ 2) :
66     t = travel d c s ρ := by
67   have spec := travel_spec dp outward unit outside
68   have scaled₁ := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => t ^ 2 * x) unit
69   have scaled₂ := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => (travel d c s ρ) ^ 2 * x) unit
70   have dc := mul_nonneg dp.le outward
71   rcases lt_trichotomy t (travel d c s ρ) with less | same | greater
72   · have strict := mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr less)
73       (show 0 < t + travel d c s ρ + 2 * d * c by nlinarith)
74     nlinarith
75   · exact same
76   · have strict := mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr greater)
77       (show 0 < t + travel d c s ρ + 2 * d * c by nlinarith)
78     nlinarith
79 
80 /-- Angular displacement from an inner leg on the circle of radius `ρ`.
81 It is zero before the elbow, and follows the straight outer ray afterwards. -/
82 noncomputable def offset (d γ ρ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
83   if ρ < d then 0 else
84     arcsin (travel d (cos (π - γ)) (sin (π - γ)) ρ * sin (π - γ) / ρ)
85 
86 /-- Before the elbow the boundary is the original radial segment. -/
87 theorem inner_arm {d γ ρ : ℝ} (inside : ρ < d) (θ : ℝ) :
88     ρ • direction (θ + offset d γ ρ) = ρ • direction θ := by
89   simp [offset, inside]
90 
91 /-- The polar and straight pieces agree at the elbow, including tangent rays. -/
92 theorem offset_at_elbow {d γ : ℝ} (dp : 0 < d)
93     (lower : π / 2 ≤ γ) (upper : γ ≤ 3 * π / 2) : offset d γ d = 0 := by
94   have outward : 0 ≤ cos (π - γ) := cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
95   have travel_zero := ray_circle_unique dp outward (cos_sq_add_sin_sq (π - γ))
96     le_rfl (le_refl 0) (by simp : (d + 0 * cos (π - γ)) ^ 2 + (0 * sin (π - γ)) ^ 2 = d ^ 2)
97   unfold offset
98   rw [if_neg (lt_irrefl d), ← travel_zero]
99   simp
100 
101 /-- Reflection reverses the displacement, so the other arm uses `-offset`. -/
102 theorem offset_reflected (d γ ρ : ℝ) : offset d (2 * π - γ) ρ = -offset d γ ρ := by
103   unfold offset
104   split_ifs with inside
105   · simp
106   · rw [show π - (2 * π - γ) = -(π - γ) by ring, cos_neg, sin_neg]
107     simp [travel, neg_div, arcsin_neg]
108 
109 /-- Exact boundary points after rotating an arm through `θ`. -/
110 theorem outer_arm {d γ ρ : ℝ} (dp : 0 < d)
111     (lower : π / 2 ≤ γ) (upper : γ ≤ 3 * π / 2) (outside : d ≤ ρ) (θ : ℝ) :
112     ρ • direction (θ + offset d γ ρ) =
113       d • direction θ + travel d (cos (π - γ)) (sin (π - γ)) ρ • direction (θ + (π - γ)) := by
114   have outward : 0 ≤ cos (π - γ) := cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
115   have polar := ray_polar_coordinates dp outward (cos_sq_add_sin_sq (π - γ)) outside
116   simp only [cos_pi_sub, sin_pi_sub] at polar
117   unfold offset
118   rw [if_neg (not_lt_of_ge outside)]
119   ext i
120   fin_cases i <;>
121     simp [direction, PiLp.smul_apply, PiLp.add_apply, cos_add, sin_add]
122   · nlinarith [congrArg (fun x : ℝ => cos θ * x) polar.1,
123       congrArg (fun x : ℝ => sin θ * x) polar.2]
124   · nlinarith [congrArg (fun x : ℝ => sin θ * x) polar.1,
125       congrArg (fun x : ℝ => cos θ * x) polar.2]
126 
127 /-- The region between the two broken arms, described circle by circle.
128 An empty angular interval gives an empty circle section; a full turn gives
129 the whole circle. Thus bounded and unbounded wedges use the same formula. -/
130 noncomputable def polarRegion (d γ lower upper : ℝ) : Set Plane := {z |
131   z = 0 ∨ ∃ ρ θ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ z = ρ • direction θ ∧
132     lower + offset d γ ρ ≤ θ ∧ θ ≤ upper - offset d γ ρ}
133 
134 /-- Rotating either arm away from the region only enlarges it.
135 `outer_arm` verifies that the circle sections follow the actual straight rays. -/
136 theorem rotate_arms {d γ lower₁ upper₁ lower₂ upper₂ : ℝ}
137     (lower_moves : lower₂ ≤ lower₁) (upper_moves : upper₁ ≤ upper₂) :
138     polarRegion d γ lower₁ upper₁ ⊆ polarRegion d γ lower₂ upper₂ := by
139   rintro z (zero | ⟨ρ, θ, positive, position, left, right⟩)
140   · exact Or.inl zero
141   · exact Or.inr ⟨ρ, θ, positive, position, by linarith, by linarith⟩
142 
143 end SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge
